title: Mapping the Evolution of ODF with LibreOffice

This presentation explores how ODF evolved from Version 1.2 to Version 1.4 using LibreOffice Calc, LLM-assisted analysis, and a knowledge graph.

The project compares specification changes, application support, and interoperability issues while keeping verified results in an open and reusable form. Presented at LibreOffice Conference 2026 in Pordenone, Italy.
